I'm Felix, a French filmmaker/digital artist/language teacher and humanitarian worker.
I Love people and even more talking with them, this is how I became polyglot and I now use this knowledge to help learners from all over the world to do the same.
teacher_info.short_signature: Certified French / English / Italian teacher with more than 7 years of experience
teacher_info.introduction: I'm a French Filmmaker (having BA in Fine Arts / Professional BA in Multimedia/Audiovisual Production / 1st grade in Cinema studies passed in French universities) working in several countries across Europe producing documentary films and videos for the music industry and schools (which has enabled me to learn English, Spanish and Italian on the field). Since two years now I'm focusing my life on the "migrants", "refugees"' situation and humanitarian working life. I've grown my experiences and skills to be able to help in any kind of situation and I naturally came to work a lot on school projects, teaching English, and French and it's something I found really meaningful. It helped me to get more confident in my teaching approach and to be able to run classes for any kind of students from beginners to intermediate, children to adults in both languages, French and English. As I started my teaching experience in completely informal conditions, (even though I passed and still follow more "academic" and "official" teaching approaches, like FLE or TOEFL) my lessons are essentially based on lively conversations and topic based activities putting the student in a position where he can learn and practice the language in a useful and efficient way. Working with many different students' backgrounds and needs, the most important for me is to understand what are their motivations and purposes, trying to fit the best their expectations in my teaching approach.

Do you want to do well in your French embassy interview or be ready for TCF, DALF, or DELF exams? Our special course is here for you! With us, you'll learn everything you need to be at your best on the big day.

Our teachers are really nice and they'll help you feel comfortable in French. We'll do practical exercises, simulate interviews, and immerse you in French culture so you'll be ready for anything.

Don't miss this chance to make your dreams come true! Join us now and see the difference for yourself!

pro_course_detail.title: French Fiesta - Gain confidence in your french (A2 -C1)
pro_course_detail.description:
French Description:
Vous avez déjà quelques bases en français et vous voulez passer à la vitesse supérieure ? Parfait ! Notre cours pour niveaux intermédiaires est là pour vous aider à franchir ce cap et à devenir un véritable pro de la langue de Molière !

Dans ce cours, on met l'accent sur des conversations de la vie quotidienne pour voyager, faire des affaires ou étudier pour votre master. Vous pratiquerez votre français dans des situations réelles et apprendrez à maîtriser les subtilités de la langue de manière amusante et interactive.

Alors, prêt à relever de nouveaux défis linguistiques ? Rejoignez-nous dès maintenant et laissez-nous vous montrer que le français n'aura bientôt plus aucun secret pour vous !

So, you've already got some basics in French and you want to kick it up a notch? Perfect! Our intermediate-level course is here to help you take that next step and become a true pro in the language of Molière!

Now that you've mastered the fundamentals, it's time to tackle new challenges. We know that conjugation can be a real puzzle, but don't worry, we're here to guide you through the intricacies of French verbs. And what about the complexity of idiomatic expressions? But don't fret, we'll demystify all of that together!

In this course, we'll focus on everyday conversations, whether it's for traveling, doing business, or studying for your master's degree. We'll simulate dialogues on various topics, giving you the opportunity to practice your French in real-life situations.

So, ready to take on new challenges and become a true expert in the French language? Join us now and let us show you that French will soon have no secrets for you!

pro_course_detail.title: Bonjour la france-complete beginner (A1)
pro_course_detail.description:
French Description:

Alors, vous voulez apprendre le français, hein ? Pas de panique ! Notre cours pour débutants est là pour rendre tout ça aussi facile que de manger un croissant un matin ensoleillé à Paris !

On sait que la prononciation peut être un vrai casse-tête, surtout ce fameux "r" qui fait peur à tout le monde ! Mais ne vous inquiétez pas, on va s'en occuper. On va vous montrer que même si vous sonnez un peu comme un canard en ce moment, avec un peu de pratique, vous pourrez chanter "La Marseillaise" avec les meilleurs d'entre eux !

En plus de rigoler avec la prononciation, on va aussi s'amuser avec les accents, la grammaire, et tout ce qui fait la beauté de la langue française. Et pour que ça reste intéressant, on a préparé un plan d'apprentissage qui vous fera dire "Ooh la la !" à chaque nouvelle leçon.

Alors, prêt à devenir un vrai Français ? Rejoignez-nous maintenant et laissez-nous vous montrer que parler français peut être aussi facile que de manger un fromage baguette au bord de la Seine !



English Description:

So, you want to learn French, huh? Don't worry! Our beginner's course is here to make it as easy as eating a croissant on a sunny morning in Paris!

We know pronunciation can be a real puzzle, especially that infamous "r" that scares everyone! But don't worry, we've got you covered. We'll show you that even if you sound a bit like a duck right now, with a little practice, you'll be able to sing "La Marseillaise" with the best of them!

In addition to having fun with pronunciation, we'll also play around with accents, grammar, and everything that makes the French language beautiful. And to keep it interesting, we've prepared a learning plan that will make you say "Ooh la la!" with every new lesson.

So, ready to become a real Frenchy? Join us now and let us show you that speaking French can be as easy as eating a baguette with cheese by the Seine!

pro_course_detail.description:

Age group:  small children, children, teenagers
Meeting room: Whereby (different than italki)
Time to cancel or reprogramm a class : 24h before the class (italki policy)

-----------------------------------------------
Welcome to “French for kids” 🙂

If your child is between 3 and 6, I use a specific bilingual method called "Hocus & Lotus", based on teaching your child to naturally communicate in French as if it was his/her second mother tongue! The course is divided into stories which your child will experience through singing, acting, speaking and listening. 
It has been developed by the University of La Sapienza, Rome, with the support of the European Community, and has been scientifically proven for over 20 years to be the most successful method to teach languages to children. I specialized in this method at the university where the method was founded, and I became a certified specialist in teaching languages to children, as well as in using the "Hocus & Lotus" methodology. I have been working with the method for 6 years now, with kids from the age of 2 to 7, in individual classes as well as in groups of kids. 
In an online class a parent or caregiver should be either present in the room (compulsory for under 4) or in the next room and reachable at any time in case it is necessary (over 5).

Also, for this method it is important that your child believes that I cannot speak his/her mother tongue. 

To know more about the method, please check the following links:
Italian (Founders website): www.hocus-lotus.edu

pro_course_detail.description: Je propose toute une série de jeux de devinette (guess game) pour connaître des expressions idiomatiques françaises usuelles avec leurs équivalents en anglais (et parfois dans d'autres langues). Je donnerai des pistes (clues) si nécessaire, et une phrase qui contient l'expression. Par exemple: "Il a fait des pieds et des mains pour garder son travail". Et... à la fin, si tu me dis: "je donne ma langue au chat" (I surrender), je te l'expliquerai ("He moved heaven and earth to keep his job").

pro_course_detail.title: Parler de soi-même. Pour briser déjà la glace, je commence: Si tu désire me connaître, tu va savoir...
pro_course_detail.description:
... que je suis né pratiquement au centre du monde (la gare SNCF de Perpignan, selon Dali) et que j'ai vécu 19 ans à Céret, au pied des Pyrénées Orientales, dans un territoire qui était catalan et espagnol avant 1659, à 30 km de la mer Méditerranée et juste à côté de l'Espagne (à 2 km à vol d'oiseau), mon pays d'adoption, même si mes parents ne sont pas Espagnols.
La fameuse série télévisée espagnole "Cuéntame" m'a fort intéressé car j'avais l'âge du jeune protagoniste Carlito, mais la réalité était bien différente en France qu'elle ne l'était dans l'Espagne de la fin du régime de Franco et vers la fin du 20e siècle. Dès 1984 j'ai commencé à vivre en Espagne. Je comprends ou parle 10 langues (je connais bien le processus d'apprentissage par lequel tu passes) mais les trois que je domine le mieux sont le français (bien sûr), l'espagnol (plus d'années vécues en Espagne qu'en France) et l'anglais (langue que j'enseigne et je traduis). 
J'ai encore de tas de choses à partager mais j'espère aussi t'écouter me parler de toi. À bientôt donc...

pro_course_detail.title: La conversation en français (espagnol ou anglais) pour apprendre la culture au-delà des mots
pro_course_detail.description:
Je te propose d'apprendre de nos petites ou grandes différences culturelles qui se reflètent souvent d'ailleurs dans nos diverses langues et en particulier dans nos expressions idiomatiques (c'est à dire "propre" et plus ou moins uniques à notre langue). Au fur et à mesure que nous échangerons, nous découvrirons des points d'intérêt communs, sans pour autant avoir forcément que des "atomes crochus" (aimer 120% ce qu'un autre aime), que ce soit dans le sport (je raffole de tennis), la gastronomie (j'ai des trucs pour faire de bonnes paellas, gaspachos et sangrías, et j'ai hâte de connaître tes recettes favorites), ou autre. 
Qui a dit que l'acquisition du vocabulaire dans une langue étrangère était ennuyeux?
Je t'attends pour partager et échanger sur les richesses de nos cultures respectives. 
C'est super chouette (genial) que nous ne sommes pas des clons!

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you struggle to watch movies in french without subtitle or to understand native French speakers when they talk fast? Do you feel frustrated or overwhelmed by the speed and the slang of the French language? Do you want to improve your listening skills ?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, then this course is for you. In this course, you will learn to watch movies in french without subtitle or to understand native French speakers when they talk fast, with practical tips and exercises.

 we will dive deep into the nuances of conversational French at full throttle. From the streets of Paris to lively café conversations, you'll learn to decipher and engage with French at its natural pace. You will also learn some common examples of fast-spoken French, such as:

Dropping the “e” in the middle or at the end of words, such as “la boulanj’rie” for “la boulangerie” (the bakery) or “p’ti” for “petit” (small).

Contracting “tu” and “te” to “t’” before a vowel, such as “t’as” for “tu as” (you have) or “t’en vas” for “tu t’en vas” (you are leaving).

Verlan and Argot: Decode the slang and inverted words used in casual French conversations, like "flic" for police or "meuf" for woman.

Explore the fusion of words and sounds that occur in rapid speech, such as "je suis" becoming "chuis" or "vous avez" becoming "vous avez" pronounced as "vouzavé".

- "Qu'est-ce que tu fais ce soir ?" -> "Tufaisquoi c'soir ?" (What are you doing tonight?)

By the end of this course, you will be able to understand and speak fast-spoken French better, and you will be able to communicate with native speakers more easily. You will also have more fun and enjoyment in learning French.
